text:
alex: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 needs 2x LGTM before midnight PST to merge the schema shim for kv_index. This is blocking the midnight cutover, can we get quick eyes?

maria: On it, alex. Quick q — does this require a downtime window or is it online-migrateable?

alex: Online migrateable. Migration runs in small batches, we verified it on staging. No downtime expected but if it stalls we have an autobackout. See deploy notes below.

devon: Dropping by to review now. Will focus on the migration script and the rollback path.

olga: I can run the smoke after merge from QA side. ETA 15m after merge to validate query paths.

alex: Thanks. Rollback plan: keep previous schema version in code, migration is reversible with `ALTER TABLE kv DROP COLUMN idx_tmp;` if needed, and we have a queued abort job. Full snippet:```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE kv ADD COLUMN idx_tmp jsonb;
-- backfill in 1000-row batches
COMMIT;
```

maria: Looks sensible. Minor nit: add a short sleep between batches in the migration job to limit write IO.

devon: Reviewed the PR diff — code looks fine, tests pass locally except one flaky test `TestKVCompact`. I left a comment with a suggested assert tweak.

alex: Pushed a tiny test change per your suggestion. PTAL.

devon: LGTM (except CI flake note). I'll re-run CI.

release-bot: Deploy window reminder — scheduled cutover at 00:00 PST. Please ensure 2 approvals before 23:50 PST to allow CI -> merge -> smoke.

olga: QA is on standby. If merge before 23:50 I can start validation immediately.

maria: LGTM. Added a :thumbsup:.

alex: Great, that's 2x. Thanks @devon @maria. I'll queue the merge and watch CI.

devon: CI rerun is green. Merging when green.

alex: Merged at 23:32 PST. Triggering migration job now.

olga: Smoke started — checking top-level queries and embeddings pipeline.

olga: Smoke: initial pass good, sampling results match expectations, no elevated error rates. :white_check_mark:

alex: Copy — keeping an eye on metrics for 30m. If any anomalies we autobackout.

maria: Awesome, thanks all for quick turnaround.

devon: Nice team hustle. :raised_hands:
